newsitem.title: DUBAI: Rates on one, three, six month Saudi t-bills mixed.
newsitem.headline: Rates on one, three, six month Saudi t-bills mixed.

text.p: Yields on one, three and six month treasury bills were mixed at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering worth three billion riyals, a banker said.
The yield on 28-day and 91-day bills were unchanged at 5.3585 and 5.4598 percent respectively. The rate on 182-day bills dropped to 5.4444 percent from 5.5381 a week ago.
One, three- and six-month riyal interbank deposit rates were at 5-1/2, 3/8 percent, 5-5/8, 1/2 and 5-11/16, 9/16 percent respectively.
